title: Luscious Garlic Basque Shrimp Pil-Pil
description: Umami-rich Basque-inspired dish featuring shrimp, passata, and yuzu-cure, perfect for adventurous eaters.
instructions: Heat the raclette grill to medium-high heat.
Add the olive oil to the grill and swirl it around to coat the surface.
Add the minced garlic to the grill and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the pimentón and cook for an additional 30 seconds.
Add the passata to the grill and cook for 3-4 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauce has thickened slightly.
Add the shrimp to the grill and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, until pink and cooked through.
Season the shrimp with yuzu-cured sea salt and red pepper flakes (if using).
Transfer the shrimp to a plate and serve immediately, garnished with chopped parsley (if using) and a squeeze of fresh lemon juice (if using).
Serve the shrimp with the passata sauce spooned over the top.
